templates.title: Waiso
templates.description: Run scripts and flows on a schedule or as an API, with every run kept. Fill in the three secrets (openssl rand -hex 32, openssl rand -base64 32, openssl rand -hex 32) and the addresses browsers use to reach ports 8080, 3000 and 3001.
templates.note: The first account created becomes the Admin. To update, change the image tags in the stack to the new version and redeploy; your data stays in the volumes.

env.name: WAISO_VERSION
env.label: Waiso version
env.description: The release every service runs; change it to update them all

env.name: DB_CREDENTIALS_KEY
env.label: Credentials key
env.description: openssl rand -base64 32 (keep it: it opens your saved credentials)
